verdict.rationale: GitHub Projects is a SaaS planning tool that holds user data, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers training-data opt-out, data-usage controls, or AI privacy policy. The items describe views, fields, workflows, API automation and Copilot assignment, none of which address whether user data is used to train models.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
